rationale: Construction-guided execution for the accepted unit unit-claim-config-store-delivery. Source reading says the only StoreConfiguration call site is inside applySingle (fsm.go:118), and runFSM reaches applySingle only when the FSM does not implement BatchingFSM (fsm.go:127-186), while BatchingFSM.ApplyBatch is documented to receive LogConfiguration entries (fsm.go:51-69). This exploration runs a single-voter cluster whose FSM implements BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore, commits one LogConfiguration entry (AddNonvoter), waits for a barrier queued after it so the FSM goroutine has processed it, and reports whether StoreConfiguration was called versus whether the entry only reached ApplyBatch. Exploration output is construction knowledge only: it is not a fixed check, not Evidence and not a verdict on the obligation.
question: When a FSM implements both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore and a LogConfiguration entry is committed, does the library call ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration, or does the entry only reach BatchingFSM.ApplyBatch so that StoreConfiguration is never invoked?
